workspace_kind_valid.name: workspace_kind_valid
workspace_kind_valid.value: ("workspace"."kind" = 'personal' AND "workspace"."personal_owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "workspace"."family_owner_id" IS NULL AND "workspace"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "workspace"."deleted_by" IS NULL) OR ("workspace"."kind" = 'family' AND "workspace"."personal_owner_id" IS NULL AND "workspace"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace"."family_owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace"."timezone" IS NOT NULL)

leg_role_category.name: leg_role_category
leg_role_category.value: ("ledger_leg"."role" IN ('income','expense') AND "ledger_leg"."category_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ledger_leg"."role" IN ('transfer_out','transfer_in') AND "ledger_leg"."category_id" IS NULL)

transfer_positive_finite.name: transfer_positive_finite
transfer_positive_finite.value: "transfer_detail"."rate_numerator">0 AND "transfer_detail"."rate_denominator">0 AND "transfer_detail"."rate_decimal">0 AND "transfer_detail"."rate_numerator" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric,'Infinity'::numeric) AND "transfer_detail"."rate_denominator" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric,'Infinity'::numeric) AND "transfer_detail"."rate_decimal" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric,'Infinity'::numeric)

goal_type_target.name: goal_type_target
goal_type_target.value: ("goal"."type"='ordinary' AND "goal"."ordinary_target" IS NOT NULL AND "goal"."ordinary_target">0 AND "goal"."ordinary_target" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric,'Infinity'::numeric,'-Infinity'::numeric)) OR ("goal"."type"='reserve' AND "goal"."ordinary_target" IS NULL)

savings_plan_amount.name: savings_plan_amount
savings_plan_amount.value: "savings_plan"."monthly_contribution" IS NULL OR ("savings_plan"."monthly_contribution">=0 AND "savings_plan"."monthly_contribution" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric,'Infinity'::numeric,'-Infinity'::numeric))
